question: Who led the Salt March to Dandi in 1930?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Mahatma Gandhi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Mahatma Gandhi**, also known as **Mohandas Karamchand Gandhi**, led the **Salt March to Dandi in 1930**, which was part of the **Civil Disobedience Movement**.
 
• The march began on **12th March 1930**, from **Sabarmati Ashram** and ended on **6th April 1930**, in the coastal village of **Dandi**, located in the present-day Gujarat.
